metadata.sampling_design: Stratified scenario allocation with a declared latent-factor Gaussian copula, shared shocks across alternatives, marginal-preserving inverse transforms, and matched independent/correlation-stress counterfactuals.

decision.title: Resilient Supply-Network Design
decision.domain: Supply-chain operations research, systems engineering, risk analysis, and sustainable operations
decision.question: Choose a three-year supply-network design that meets service and capital constraints while reducing disruption recovery time and concentration risk.
blocking_reasons: evidence is not labeled for operational use
decision.feasibility_basis: one-sided 95% upper confidence bound on simulated constraint-breach frequency

current-lean.label: Current lean network
current-lean.description: Maintain low inventory and primary single-region sourcing.

dual-source.label: Dual-source critical components
dual-source.description: Qualify second suppliers and hold targeted safety stock for critical parts.

regional-hub.label: Regional production hub
regional-hub.description: Build a regional postponement and final-assembly hub close to demand.

flexible-network.label: Flexible multi-region network
flexible-network.description: Combine supplier diversification, modular production, digital visibility, and pre-negotiated surge capacity.

factors.label: Systemic adverse demand and delivery shock
factors.description: A shared latent shock moves outcome distributions across criteria and alternatives in the adverse direction; signs follow each criterion's value direction.

evidence.type: Synthetic network simulation summaries and engineering estimates
evidence.as_of: Synthetic demonstration; no production as-of date
evidence.causal_claim_status: No causal claim; outcomes are scenario-based engineering estimates.
limitations: Supplier failures are not modeled with an explicit dependency network.
Inventory policies are summarized inside each alternative.
The Gaussian copula and factor loadings are synthetic assumptions; tail dependence may differ in real data and requires domain approval.

decision_notes: A production model should include network topology, correlated failures, inventory optimization, and recovery policies.
Worker and supplier-community impacts should be added before deployment.
